summary: The paper investigates the primordial trispectra in the general multi-field DBI inflationary model. It focuses on the contributions from the interaction of four entropic modes mediating one adiabatic mode to the trispectra. The study calculates the general form of the 4-point correlation functions and analyzes the shape diagrams for two specific momentum configurations: the equilateral configuration and the specialized planar configuration.
evidence: In this paper, we investigated the primordial trispectra produced by the "scalar-exchanging" interaction of the general multi-field DBI inflationary model. In section 2, we studied the power spectra of the entropic modes and adiabatic modes without considering the mass term and the mixing term ⟨QsQσ⟩. In contrast with the single field model, the curvature perturbations generally evolve in time on the large scales in the multi-field scenario, because the entropic modes can source the curvature perturbations on the super horizon scales, which can be described by the transfer coefficient TRS. So, if the transfer process is strong (TRS ≫ 1), the late time curvature perturbations will be mostly of the entropic origin.
